title: India's lake full of skeletons. The DNA made it stranger. #shorts

scenes.label: UTTARAKHAND, INDIA
lines: High in the Himalayas, at five thousand metres, there's a frozen lake.
And it's full of human skeletons.

scenes.label: 300+ PEOPLE
lines: The remains of more than three hundred people.

scenes.label: THE LEGEND
lines: Local legend says a king's pilgrimage was caught in a storm of giant hailstones.
Then, in 2019, scientists tested their DNA.

scenes.label: THE DNA RESULT
lines: Most were from South Asia, and died around 800 AD.
But fourteen of them had ancestry from Greece and Crete.
And they died a thousand years later, around 1800.
So what were Greek travellers doing on a remote Himalayan pilgrimage route?

scenes.label: ROOPKUND LAKE
lines: Follow for one mystery every day.

youtube.title: India's lake full of skeletons. The DNA made it stranger. #shorts
youtube.description:
High in the Himalayas, Roopkund lake holds the remains of 300+ people. Legend says a king's pilgrimage died in a hailstorm. Then DNA showed two groups who died 1,000 years apart - one with ancestry from Greece and Crete.

Source: Harney et al. 2019, Nature Communications 10:3670.
